title: Operating Lines of Credit Member Disclosure — Interest Day Count, Billing Cycle, Matured Balances and Payment Order
content:
This disclosure sets out, for each of the Operating Lines of Credit, how interest is counted and billed, when a bill falls due, how matured principal is priced and in what order an undesignated remittance is applied.

## Terms

- **Day-count convention**: the interest day-count convention. Under the actual/365 convention the daily interest equals the principal multiplied by the annual rate and divided by 365, for each calendar day.
- **Billing frequency**: how often accrued interest is billed — monthly, quarterly (calendar quarters), annual (each anniversary of the term start) or at maturity.
- **Due days**: the calendar days after the last day of a billed interest period on which that bill is due.
- **Post-maturity add-on**: the percentage points added to the contract rate on principal still unpaid after the matured-payoff grace period.
- **Matured-payoff grace**: the calendar days after the maturity date during which matured principal still accrues at the contract rate.
- **Payment order**: the order in which an undesignated remittance is applied across what is owed on the line.

## Schedule

| Product | Day count | Billing frequency | Bill due (calendar days after period end) | Post-maturity add-on (points) | Matured-payoff grace (calendar days) | Undesignated payment order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | Actual/365 | Quarterly | 15 | 3.0 (3) | 30 | Fees, then interest, then principal |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | Actual/365 | Annual | 15 | 4.0 (4) | 30 | Fees, then interest, then principal |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | Actual/365 | At maturity | 15 | 4.0 (4) | 30 | Fees, then interest, then principal |
| Revolving Operating Line | Actual/365 | Quarterly | 15 | 4.0 (4) | 30 | Fees, then interest, then principal |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | Actual/365 | Monthly | 10 | 4.0 (4) | 15 | Interest, then fees, then principal |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | Actual/365 | Monthly | 10 | 3.5 | 15 | Interest, then fees, then principal |

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates and balances)

- A Revolving Operating Line bill for the quarter ending 30 June is due 15 calendar days later, on 15 July; a Borrowing Base Operating Line bill for the month ending 31 May is due on 10 June.
- One day's interest on USD 365,000 of principal at 7.300% a year under the actual/365 convention is USD 365,000 multiplied by 7.300% and divided by 365, that is USD 73.00.
- On an ExpressLine Operating Credit maturing on 1 March, matured principal still accrues at the contract rate through 31 March (30 calendar days after maturity) and at the contract rate plus 4 points from 1 April.
